title: 2027 mass nominations for county boards
summary: On September 23 the board planned recruiting for the 2027 mass nominations: applications are due November 11th, and members will recruit at the county fair and at the November 21st senior fair at the Cameron Center. The chair said 64 of 77 seats are open after removing members eligible for reappointment. Members agreed to reuse the existing interview questions and grading.

timeline.text: The chair said the list shows 77 seats, with 64 open after taking out members eligible for reappointment.
A member suggested sending applications to the working group members as they come in.
Members agreed to use the existing interview questions and grading.
Applications for the 2027 mass nominations are due November 11th.
Two members will recruit at the senior fair on November 21st at the Cameron Center.
Board members will work recruiting shifts at the county fair.
Staff agreed to bring a plan and timeline for the Temporary Investigative Group (TIG) to the next meeting.
Motion to form one Temporary Investigative Group (TIG) for mass nominations: The board approved a new motion to form one TIG to interview, score and recommend applicants.
The board voted, with five ayes, to form two TIGs, small groups of members, to interview, score and recommend applicants.
